title: Inventor to Revit Data Exchange Governance

scope.purpose: Govern the exchange of Inventor design data into Revit and coordination environments, including purpose, fidelity, acceptance, traceability, ownership, change, and downstream reliance.
scope.boundary: This standard defines exchange governance and acceptance boundaries. Detailed execution mechanics remain in the governed workflow and instruction set.

requirements.statement: Each Inventor-to-Revit exchange shall declare its intended downstream purpose and the required geometric and information fidelity before export.

Inventor shall remain authoritative for source mechanical fabrication geometry while Revit remains authoritative for the governed project BIM context; the CDE shall govern published accepted exchange packages according to project information-management rules.

Exchange models shall preserve traceability to the Inventor source and shall meet declared acceptance criteria for naming, fidelity, performance, placement or coordinates, and dependency hygiene before downstream reliance.
Accepted exchange packages shall be published through the governed project information environment and registered or recorded with sufficient identity and lifecycle context for downstream consumers.
Source changes that affect an exchanged representation shall trigger governed re-export, revalidation, register update, and communication of downstream impact.
An exchange representation shall not transfer fabrication-authoring authority from Inventor to Revit or project-publication authority from the CDE back to the authoring source.
